profile.headline: Full Stack Developer (React.js, Node.js, HTML, CSS, Node, AWS Services, Aurora DB, and Oracle SQL) at Asurion
profile.summary: Software engineer with a proven ability to identify, develop, and implement solutions to large-scale challenges for several large (i.e. $21M+ in revenue) companies over a 10+ year career as a senior consultant for two premier consulting firms. Prior to transitioning to software engineering, I displayed analytical and project management expertise in developing an analytical tool used in the $150M+ cost savings initiative for a national cancer center that aided in focusing efforts on greatest opportunities for savings. As a life-long learner with a passion for coding, I went on to attend a 1,000+ hour Full-Stack bootcamp to learn new skills (e.g. Ruby, Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, ReactJS, etc.) while also sharpening existing skills. I am now looking to apply my passion and experience in a challenging position on a collaborative development team focused on creating high-quality, intuitive applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
Client Initiatives lead developer responsible for design, implementation, and coordination of enrollment activities. Leads teams of 3-4 developers to configure enrollment pipelines and build a la carte client solutions.

I work on a team of six developers as part of the enrollment team at Asurion where I develop highly scalable RESTful client agnostic Microservices using Node JS, Express, Oracle Database, PostgreSQL, Redis and other AWS services like S3, ECS, Lambda, SNS, and SQS.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description: I work on a team of nine developers as part of the enrollment team at Asurion. Develop highly scalable RESTful client agnostic Microservices using Node JS, Express, Oracle Database, PostgreSQL, Redis and other AWS services like S3, ECS, Lambda, SNS, and SQS.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
As part of a ten-person team, I am responsible for the modernization of pre-existing government web applications using a stack composed of ReactJS, NodeJS, and PostgreSQL. On these web applications, I build responsive frontend UIs and develop business logic to communicate between the client, microservices, and database.
• Attended daily scrum meetings for developers and business analysts to set expectations for the day, convey what was worked on and any blockers impeding progress.
Implemented frontend UIs for search screens and search results pages to handle ElasticSearch API requests with up to 1000 records of pagination at a time built with ReactJS, Bootstrap, PubSubJS, and AG-Grid. 
• Developed an automated query process using NodeJS, and PostgreSQL that notifies 50K+ users via email when there has been a new hit on a saved query. The feature queries 350M records in the database using PostgreSQL functions, then uses elastic search to find new hits and then emails the client their respective lists.
• Using Gitlab and JIRA, 1K+ resolved tickets from the development of new applications. Tickets ranged from cosmetic issues to the completion of full features on the Frontend and Backend.

positions.title: Senior Associate
positions.description:
Provided healthcare advisory services to health systems, local governments, pharmacies, and insurance plans. The primary services I provided were business development, finance, reimbursement, and capital planning.
• Worked on a team of 8 to analyze the impact of Maryland’s healthcare system transitioning from an all-payer model to the national prospective payment system. My role on this team was to create a profit and loss financial statement for the state of Maryland under both payment models.
• Identified profitable patient populations within a target hospital’s service area and assisted in the development of a market share policy to defend the state’s $3M in cost reduction. 
• Assisted one of the nation’s premier cancer centers in the identification of $150M in cost-saving opportunities by trending operating expenses by the department over a three-year period. 
• Completed a vendor spend analysis that was used to identify potential cost savings and aid in value lever workshops.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
As a member of a PMO team, I served as a business manager on multiple cost plus fixed fee contracts with a total value of $143M. I worked closely with program managers, senior management, and subcontractors to assist in monthly reporting and funding allocation of each contract.
• Performed profitability, variance, and risk analyses to assess profit margin and risk of each contract.
• Created monthly financial client deliverables tracking budget compliance, time analysis, and current 
burn rates.
• Managed financial relationships with 30 subcontractors, processing and approving invoices, identifying discrepancies, and tracking funding to subcontractors’ spend rates.
• Conducted detailed outlay, funding exhaustion, invoice-to-date, and various other analyses.

honors.title: High5
honors.description: For recognition during the IASETAC March 2013 financial cycle, when the primary automated financial reporting system experienced a terminal issue. I had the sole responsibility of training the surge support software developer on the functionality of the financial reporting in order to commence investigation into a long term fix for the issue and allow for automated reporting.

honors.title: Performance and Team Award
honors.description: Outstanding contribution to the IASETAC PMO and being a dedicated professional, someone who the GO TEAM can depend on to provide valuable services.

projects.title: Elemental Turn-Up
projects.description:
A periodic table teaching aide in the form of an online game. This web application presents users with a periodic table that can be used in either a learning or game format. The idea behind this was to help teachers make learning the periodic table exciting. In building this web-based application, I displayed a working knowledge of ReactJS, PostgreSQL, Ruby On Rails, and RESTful methods to develop frontend design, client-side validations, and the API framework.
• Styled responsive React components with Semantic UI for all screen sizes, leveraging React conditional rendering techniques and imports to create a consistent and streamlined application UI.
• Securely hashed and salted user passwords by utilizing Bcrypt’s secure hashing algorithm and custom iteration count in ExpressJS Middleware all prior to saving any sensitive user information.
• Built the application to allow users to upload product data to the PostgreSQL Database through the RESTful API using Ruby On Rails.
• Developed a PostgreSQL database that stored relational data between users, teams, and projects to leverage third normal form design and reduce data duplication by configuring foreign key constraints and using SQL joins and aggregate queries.
• Built deployment pipeline for the frontend and backend application through Github actions to deploy to Firebase after all test cases were passed along with linting.

projects.title: Moocher
projects.description:
Serves as an e-commerce tool that allows users to identify and borrow items from other users within their network. In building this web-based application, I displayed a working knowledge of ReactJS, PostgreSQL, Ruby On Rails, Redux, and RESTful methods to develop frontend design, client-side validations, google maps, and the API framework.
• Architected RESTful API utilizing ExpressJS as the server with lightweight middleware to handle security, logging, cors & authentication between client-side applications while developing 10+ endpoints following MVC pattern
• Designed mobile responsive experience to integrate Semantic UI, which ensures consistent delivery of a high-quality dynamic UI and intuitive UX for users to log tickets for bugs, stories & epics.
• Securely hashed and salted user passwords by utilizing Bcrypt’s secure hashing algorithm and custom iteration count in ExpressJS Middleware all prior to saving any sensitive user information.
• Implemented Google Maps API to the frontend user experience, displaying a map on the page and markers on the different rented items in the selected geographical area.
• Engineered the SEO Lighthouse report to hit high standards: Performance 70, Accessibility 94, Best Practices 100, and SEO 90 by following best practices.
